description: This file extends the ChannelsSettings class with private utility functions and computed properties to handle channel status, UI coloring, summaries, details, and enabling logic for different communication channels such as WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Google Chat, Signal, and iMessage within a macOS application. It manages fetching, decoding, and displaying channel-specific info and state, including error handling and status updates.

methods.name: channelStatus
methods.description: Fetches and decodes the status snapshot for a specific channel ID and type.

methods.name: configuredChannelTint
methods.description: Determines the UI color for a channel based on its configured, error, and running states.

methods.name: configuredChannelSummary
methods.description: Provides a status summary string indicating whether a channel is configured or running.

methods.name: appendProbeDetails
methods.description: Appends detailed probe status information to a list of strings.

methods.name: finishDetails
methods.description: Compiles probe details lines into a single string and clears the lines list.

methods.name: finishProbeDetails
methods.description: Wrapper to finish probe details and generate a summary string.

methods.name: whatsAppTint
methods.description: UI color based on WhatsApp channel status.

methods.name: telegramTint
methods.description: UI color based on Telegram channel status.

methods.name: discordTint
methods.description: UI color based on Discord channel status.

methods.name: googlechatTint
methods.description: UI color based on Google Chat channel status.

methods.name: signalTint
methods.description: UI color based on Signal channel status.

methods.name: imessageTint
methods.description: UI color based on iMessage channel status.

methods.name: whatsAppSummary

methods.description: Status summary string for Telegram channel.

methods.name: orderedChannels
methods.description: Returns an ordered list of channels based on store snapshot or fallback list.

methods.name: enabledChannels
methods.description: Returns list of currently enabled channels.

methods.name: availableChannels
methods.description: Returns list of channels not currently enabled.

methods.name: ensureSelection
methods.description: Ensures that a channel is selected, defaulting to the first if none is selected or if current is invalid.

methods.name: channelEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a channel is enabled based on its status and account activity.

methods.name: channelSection
methods.description: Provides the UI section for a specific channel (uses ViewBuilder).

methods.name: channelTint
methods.description: Returns the tint color for a specific channel based on its status.

methods.name: channelSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary string of a channel's status.

methods.name: channelDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed string info about a channel's status.

methods.name: channelLastCheckText
methods.description: Returns the relative age string for last check time.

methods.name: channelLastCheck
methods.description: Retrieves the last check date for a channel.

methods.name: channelHasError
methods.description: Indicates if a channel has an error or disconnected state.

methods.name: resolveChannelTitle
methods.description: Resolves user-friendly label for a channel ID.

methods.name: resolveChannelDetailTitle
methods.description: Resolves detailed label for a channel ID.

methods.name: resolveChannelSystemImage
methods.description: Resolves system image name for a channel ID.

methods.name: channelStatusDictionary
methods.description: Returns the raw dictionary status for a channel ID.
